narrative.overview:
The site mirrors the school's garden deck: colorful, alive, things growing in every direction, sunlight breaking through leaves, sturdy planks underfoot but playful surprises at every turn. It is not a brochure. It is a place you visit and feel something.

The system rejects three things without negotiation: the generic school template (clip-art, stock children, Comic Sans energy), the sterile institutional page (gray walls, text deserts, municipal authority), and the over-designed startup (gratuitous animation, gradient-soaked surfaces, tech aesthetics that signal software, not kindergarten).
keyCharacteristics: Warm background tones (Morning Sand) with deep ocean blue anchoring structure
Golden sun accents for calls-to-action, drawing the eye like sunlight on water
Playful shapes balanced by clear information hierarchy
Bold Nunito headings paired with clean Inter body text
Animated ocean waves bringing life without overwhelming
Zero JavaScript; all interaction via CSS

rules.name: The Sunlight Rule
rules.body: Golden Sun appears only on primary CTAs and high-priority interactive elements. Its power comes from scarcity.

rules.name: The Never-White Rule
rules.body: No surface uses pure white (#fff) or pure black (#000). Morning Sand (#fdf8f0) is the lightest. Navy Deep (#0a3f6e) is the darkest.

rules.name: The Nunito-Only Rule
rules.body: Headings always use Nunito. Body always uses Inter. Never mix. Never override.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat by default. Shadows appear as response to hover or as structural markers. Never decorative shadow on a static non-interactive element.

dos: Do use Morning Sand (#fdf8f0) as the base page background.
Do use Deep Ocean (#005da3) for all heading text.
Do reserve Golden Sun (#f59e0b) for the primary CTA per screen.
Do use wave dividers to transition between major sections.
Do keep body text at 65-75ch maximum line length.
Do use CSS-only interactions (hover, focus, checkbox toggles, details/summary).
Do include generous whitespace between sections.
Do maintain WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on all text.
donts: Don't use pure white (#fff) or pure black (#000) anywhere.
Don't use clip-art, generic stock photos, or Comic Sans-adjacent fonts.
Don't make text-heavy walls without visual breaks.
Don't add gratuitous gradient overlays, excessive animations, or SaaS-style patterns.
Don't add JavaScript for interactions that CSS can handle.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface treatment.
